title: Kostis's Auto-Patrol System
description: Scans your battle map like a pair of eyes: finds the walkable floor from the art, proposes walls, splits the map into rooms and doorways and builds a navigation mesh. Then it generates patrols for your NPCs (rounds, perimeter walks, pacing, guard posts, wandering) that route around every wall, at each creature's own speed. Patrollers keep watch with a real field of view and line of sight, and stop and stare, chase or raise the alarm. Part of Kostis's Flying Paths.

requires.reason: The Kostis's Flying Paths hub provides the launcher, map tools and shared services.
Patrols are animator animations: precise, smooth, sub-pixel movement along the generated routes.
